prompt:
Write a JavaScript function `isAnagram(s1, s2)` that returns true if s1 and s2 are anagrams (ignoring spaces and case).
Output only the JavaScript code without extra commentary.
referenceAnswer: function isAnagram(s1, s2) { const clean = s => s.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '').split('').sort().join(''); return clean(s1) === clean(s2); }
